{{Quote|A beton nya mombay m'bwa!|[[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaese]] for, "This is mine, all mine!"|<ref name="The Shadow Syndicate">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Utinni! promotional scenario}}</ref>}}
'''Dathcha''' was a male [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] adventurer and trader who served as lead scout under the leadership of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit]].

==Biography==
[[File:Dathcha.jpg|left|thumb|Dathcha]]
Dathcha was an adventurer and [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who was a member of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. At some point,<ref name="CCG" /> he<ref name="Insider93" /> came into contact with a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]],<ref name="CCG" /> a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Dathcha taunted it and escaped to tell the tale, becoming famous for it.<ref name="CCG"? />

At another point he stole [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher's]] [[EPT-212]] [[Droid detector/Legends|droid detector]], because he didn't like his "no droids" policy. However, Wuher had hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to return it, who confronted Dathcha in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and took the detector off him after knocking him unconscious.<ref name="The Shadow Syndicate" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he shot [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. He was accompanied by his nephew [[Enjikket]]. His entire clan was slaughtered by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] who were searching for the droids they had recently sold.<ref name="Episode IV" />

==Personality and traits==
Dathcha wished to leave Tatooine and explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CCG" />
